change: Replace only standalone iLearn Kmer2 block (16 columns) with Kmer3 (64 columns); all 15153 common feature columns must be exactly equal in value and order.
word_normalization: Overlapping counts/(L-k+1), as in inspected iLearn implementation, for both k values; paper denominator L remains unresolved.
fixed: six bases and CatBoost meta architecture
no tuning, threshold optimization or winner selection
control_reuse: Revalidate all saved control hashes, fit audits, predictions and settings; do not rerun or overwrite the original control.
primary: Pooled held-out MCSE accuracy difference: k3_full minus notebook_k2_full, on matched IDs/groups/labels/outer folds.
secondary: Per-model and per-fold accuracy, mean fold AUROC, MCC, sensitivity and specificity; descriptive only
Paired prediction disagreements and changed-correctness counts

uncertainty.method: 2000 paired whole-group bootstrap resamples within each fixed outer fold
uncertainty.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of pooled accuracy difference; also both accuracy intervals
uncertainty.scope: Conditional on saved fitted predictions; no model refitting, seed variation or parameter-selection uncertainty

audit.independent_word_count_check: Recount all 2968 training sequences with Python overlapping windows for both k values

limits: Exploratory follow-up after inspecting the 2-mer benchmark; not a fresh confirmatory test.
The 3-mer variant follows the paper's stated k, not a proven exact published feature matrix; normalization, feature mapping, ensemble and historical software remain unresolved.
Other feature blocks already include some 3-mer information; this isolates the standalone Kmer block, not the presence of all 3-mer information.
Published S1 settings may themselves have been selected using these labels.
Changing dimensionality can change seeded model trajectories and feature sampling; the result is the effect of this representation change under the fixed pipeline, not proof of biological causation.
No independent experimental/lentiMPRA transfer result is produced.
publication: Local only; no website edits, commits or pushes during this comparison.
